node.title: Rank-eleven dense pair cores need not coalesce
node.closure: explicit deployed-parameter multi-owner construction; local uniqueness route fence
node.statement: On the deployed KoalaBear row and sextic line field there is one received line with twelve distinct selected pair types. Each pair has an exact deficiency-one componentwise core and owns exactly 238825 globally slope-distinct, exact-size-m, support-wise MCA-bad, post-near records with support-local margin one. The 2865900 records have explanation affine rank exactly ten and error rank exactly eleven. Thus the rank-eleven dense-pair terminal imported from PR #1168, including delta<=4 and at least 200632 records, does not by itself imply a unique pair owner, a global affine owner, or coalescence of heavy pair groups. This is a route fence only: the construction is far below B_* and leaves aggregate payment and chronology-correct S/A/E routing open.
